name: Can I fix low water pressure myself, or do I need a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix low water pressure myself, or do I need a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some minor low water pressure issues can be addressed by a homeowner, such as cleaning aerators or checking the main shut-off valve. However, many common causes like hidden leaks, malfunctioning pressure regulators, or corroded pipes require specialized tools and expertise. Attempting complex repairs without proper knowledge can lead to further damage or safety hazards. A professional plumber can accurately diagnose the problem and ensure a lasting, safe repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple issues like clogged aerators might be DIY, but most low water pressure problems require a plumber. Complex repairs often need specialized tools and expertise.
